name: Yaladai (High Quality)
description: Yaladai is a powerful stimulant that grants extreme clarity, improving relaxation and focus. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next 10 minutes, the creature experiences a high that increases their current and maximum force points by 2d8. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or experience a low that lasts 4 hours, their current and maximum force points are reduced by 2d8. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw to resist addiction.
